import sys
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right


def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    lamps = data[2:2 + 2 * n]
    left = sorted(lamps[0::2])
    right = sorted(lamps[1::2])
    points = data[2 + 2 * n:2 + 2 * n + m]
    # Lamps starting at or before p, minus lamps that already ended before p.
    print(' '.join(str(bisect_right(left, p) - bisect_left(right, p)) for p in points))


main()
